agent.problem: The blank asks for the unseen word "glory" without any earlier card giving the baker a basis to reason toward it. Neither the story cards nor the answered choices distinguish glory from anger or weakness, so this tests wording the baker has not seen rather than meaning they can work out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
